# EdgeOfGrowthDynamics

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
The regime where cellular automaton dynamics operate at the boundary between expansion and collapse, characterized by sustained emergence of new structures and self-organization. Mimics criticality in neural systems, offering a framework for designing adaptive, energy-efficient computing architectures in TCC and iNEST.
